caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular tablet or plaque with worn and faded edges, featuring the image of a standing female figure with a downcast face and hands clasped at her chest. The figure is dressed in a long, dark robe and a hood or veil that covers her head and shoulders, rendered mostly in dark brown and muted purple tones. The background of the tablet is a brownish-gold color, with patches of green and red, and decorated with a vertical pattern of round, faded ornaments along both sides. There are signs of wear and deterioration at the upper left corner and scattered marks across the surface. At the top of the tablet, there is a visible loop or string, suggesting the object may have been hung. Handwritten and printed text appears below the drawing, indicating caption information and attributions, executed in pencil and red ink. The tablet is centered on an otherwise blank, off-white background.
title: Santo
